## The claim

No structural variant confirmed by two method classes removes a coding exon of a gene that also carries a rare heterozygous protein-altering allele.

**Prediction if true.** No SV called by >= 2 callers of different method classes (read-pair/split-read vs assembly), outside one insert-size of a bait edge, overlaps such an exon.

**What would refute it.** A DEL or INS does — that gene becomes the lead pair. A DUP or INV does — the gene becomes a lead only once exon coverage or k-mer copy number confirms the dosage change, since Kosugi 2019 puts short-read DUP and INV precision near a coin flip.
